data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). All 18 leaves 50; next stock is 500 or 100. This risks future income, not guaranteed long-run gain. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. State your exact intended catch and any conditions.
